content.text: {"title":"AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 1)","total":100,"criteria":[{"id":"C1","name":"Mission concept and rationale","weight":40,"max":40,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Clear and complete description of mission goals, objectives, and requirements. Relates required mission function to users and needs. References literature as appropriate."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Sufficient description of goals, objectives, requirements. Users and needs identified. Lacks specific details and/or incomplete referencing."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Poor description with unclear goals, objectives, requirements. Insufficient identification of users and needs."}]},{"id":"C2","name":"Project plan","weight":30,"max":30,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Robust plan with provision for variations and contingencies. Fits mission concept narrative, explains rationale. Includes appropriate information sources and references."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Plan presented but lacks some detail. Still sufficient to believe project is feasible."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Plan not included or lacks sufficient detail to demonstrate feasibility."}]},{"id":"C3","name":"Preliminary progress","weight":10,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Good preliminary results with brief description/interpretation. Clearly on track for completion."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Minor work completed. Results description or interpretation may be insufficient."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"No actual or useful work completed."}]},{"id":"C4","name":"Report presentation","weight":20,"max":20,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Clear logical structure, very easy to read, well-written with good spelling, grammar, appropriate style. Consistent formatting, appropriate clear graphical/tabular data, references match list and properly cited."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Not professional level but uses headings. Difficult to read, writing ok, some spelling/grammar flaws, language style not quite appropriate. Figures/tables labelled but formatting unclear/inconsistent causing loss of context. References mostly match and correctly cited."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Poorly structured, incoherent, lacks understanding of section purposes. Difficult to read, poor writing, many spelling/grammar errors, inappropriate style. Poor presentation impedes reading, inconsistent formatting, unlabelled figures/tables, references not cited or inconsistently cited."}]}],"notes":"5% of course grade. Weight column shows % of assignment and __/marks. Level bands 7-10, 4-6, 0-3 apply to all criteria."}
